calculation.description: Trailing standard deviation of daily returns restricted to negative observations. Higher values indicate greater downside risk; signal is used with negative orientation for ranking expected returns.
calculation.alignment: Value at date t uses OHLC close data through t only; forward return begins after t.

validation.regime_notes: Negative IC is economically consistent: larger downside volatility predicts weaker next-day returns. Absolute daily IC and ICIR exceed benchmark admission gates across the full sample; regime IC remained negative in 2020-22, 2023-24, and 2025-26.
